title: The largest requests to contract out
question: What are the biggest pieces of work departments asked to hand to outside firms?
finding: The largest: Airport Commission $1.50 billion (2023-07-17, West Field Area Projects); Airport Commission $700.0 million (2023-03-06, 40697-14/15); Municipal Transportation Agency $351.0 million (2024-07-15, Train control system design and procurement). 15 requests were for $100 million or more.
how: All requests read from the packets, ranked by the amount asked at that meeting; for an amendment the cumulative total is shown beside it.
limits: Large requests for capital programmes include construction budgets and design-build contracts that no civil-service class performs; the size of a request is not evidence of a problem. An approved ceiling is not spending.
